_note: What chests and breakable pieces of Weltbauer rooms may hold (src/world_kit/room_contents.gd). chest_mobs: monsters that never stand as monsters when placed, they wait as a chest. mimic_chance: share of chests set to Mimik 'Zufällig' that bite (0 to 1). max_enemies: enemies one chest or piece lets out. random_chest: gold of a chest with content 'Zufällig' is gems_base + gems_per_floor * floor, heart_chance its share with a heart; items come from the game's chest drops (items.json drops.chest). random_piece: chances (sum 1) of a broken piece with content 'Zufällig': nothing, gold_amount gold or a heart; items come from items.json drops.crate. hoard: the Schatz chest of a solved puzzle (content type hoard): gold gems_base + gems_per_floor * floor, always a heart, rolls = item drop sources of items.json drops rolled one after another (gold_crate: a rare weapon or gear plus crystal and stone), rune = gold_loot rune source. tablet: the Inschrift stone (Weltbauer part tablet): asset = its picture, foot = px it blocks (width, height), reach = px from the hero within which its text shows.
